title: Night Market Ring Toss — AI-assisted Roblox development and a first-session playtest [16+]
author: nsvictor
selftext:
We used AI assistance for Luau implementation and code review while building Night Market Ring Toss in Roblox. An AI review caught a timing bug in our first-prize cosmetic offer: winning before the price/ownership checks finished, or while a menu was open, could consume the once-per-session offer without showing it. We separated "first prize received" from "offer actually shown" and published the fix. The offer only opens the shop; it does not trigger a purchase.



That was a useful lesson in reviewing asynchronous state, but a working Studio test still doesn't tell us whether a first-time player can understand the controls on a real phone.



I'd appreciate a voluntary 3–5 minute try from an eligible 16+ Roblox account, especially on iPhone or Android. The game has physical ring throws, shared stall progress and in-experience collectible prizes. Could you enter, figure out your first throw and win a first prize within five minutes? Please reply with your device/OS and the point where you got confused or stopped.



No purchase is needed. Progress saving is included; exit/rejoin recovery is still being verified. English UI is available, while world stall signs remain Chinese. Development and this wording use AI assistance.



Play: [https://www.roblox.com/games/78723141589628/Night-Market-Ring-Toss](https://www.roblox.com/games/78723141589628/Night-Market-Ring-Toss)
